programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the competitors to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl; the returning champion takes on chefs Martel Stone and Evelyn Garcia to win over judges Antonia Lofaso and Aaron May in Flavortown's fiercest competition yet.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Chefs take on a grocery list containing dish-clashing ingredients, but the chefs have to use every item on the list.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri opens Flavortown's doors to four dessert chefs for a night of sweet treat showdowns; they hit the ground running to make a handheld fried dessert out of only ingredients they can carry and craft their signature sweets using vegetables.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives" to make their bestselling brunch using only ingredients they can fit in a small shopping bag; they must serve an updated diner dinner featuring some retro diner ingredients.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri invites four chefs from diners, drive-ins, and dives to prove their budgeting skills while making their restaurant's best-selling dish; the remaining three competitors make their personal seafood favorites while working with a $25 budget.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri's going global, beginning with Filipino island adobo in Calgary, Alberta; a food truck in Austin, TX, is serving brisket with a turmeric-and-tahini twist; a Hong Kong hotspot near Cincinnati is slinging serious stir-fry.
